name: everyday-questions
description: Questions a person working in Switzerland asks, written in plain English the way they would type them, each with the article or articles that answer it. Gold articles were checked against the article text; where two articles share the answer, finding either counts.

questions.q: How much notice do I have to give if I quit during my trial period?

Can my boss fire me while I am off sick?
How many weeks of paid vacation am I entitled to each year?
Does my employer have to keep paying my salary when I am ill and cannot work?
Is the non-compete clause in my contract enforceable after I leave the job?
Can I be dismissed on the spot without any notice?
I was fired because I complained about my rights. What compensation can I get?
Do I get extra pay for overtime hours?
Is my employer obliged to give me a work reference letter?
Who pays for my costs when I travel for work?
Is an employment contract valid if nothing was signed in writing?
What is the maximum number of hours per week an office employee can be made to work?
How long a break am I entitled to during a long working day?
Is my employer allowed to make me work on Sundays?
When is night work allowed?
What protections do pregnant employees have at work?
What counts as sexual harassment at the workplace and what can the victim claim?
Does a company with 150 staff have to check whether men and women are paid equally?
Do I have to prove gender discrimination myself, or does the employer have to disprove it?

How can I find out what personal data a company holds about me?

What must we tell people when we collect their personal data?
Does a small startup with 20 employees need to keep a register of its data processing?
Do we have to appoint a data protection officer?
How big can the fine be for breaking the data protection law?
An algorithm rejected my application automatically. Do they have to tell me?

Is it legal to send marketing emails to people who never agreed to receive them?
Can a company's terms and conditions be unfair and therefore not allowed?
Do shops have to show the final price to consumers?

How long do I have to sue a manufacturer over a defective product?
My landlord raised the rent. How long do I have to challenge it?

How much notice do I need to give to move out of my flat?
